record.question: Which of the following is a strategy to reduce antibiotic resistance in UTIs?
options: Targeted antibiotic therapy based on culture results
record.explanation: Answer C: Targeted antibiotic therapy based on culture results. For complicated UTI with culture-confirmed infection, definitive antibiotic therapy should be narrowed/targeted to culture identification and susceptibility results rather than continuing broad empiric coverage throughout. Reference: https://academic.oup.com/cid/article/82/Supplement_3/i36/8384446. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
